Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ هَدَيْتَنِيْ فَلَهَوْتُ
Translation: My God, You guided me but I became distracted

Arabic text: وَ وَعَظْتَ فَقَسَوْتُ
Translation: You admonished me but I hardened my heart

Arabic text: وَ أَبْلَيْتَ الْجَمِيلَ فَعَصَيْتُ
Translation: You bestowed upon me beautiful favors but I disobeyed

Arabic text: ثُمَّ عَرَفْتُ مَا أَصْدَرْتَ
Translation: Then I recognized what I had done

Arabic text: إِذْ عَرَّفْتَنِيهِ، فَاسْتَغْفَرْتُ فَأَقَلْتَ، فَعُدْتُ فَسَتَرْتَ
Translation: When You made me realize it, I sought forgiveness and You pardoned me, I returned to sin and You veiled me

Arabic text: فَلَكَ إِلَهِيْ الْحَمْدُ
Translation: So to You, my God, belongs all praise

Arabic text: تَقَحَّمْتُ أَوْدِيَةَ الْهَلَاكِ
Translation: I plunged into valleys of destruction

Arabic text: وَ حَلَلْتُ شِعَابَ تَلَفٍ تَعَرَّضْتُ فِيهَا لِسَطَوَاتِكَ
Translation: And descended into ravines of ruin, exposing myself to Your punishments

Arabic text: وَ بِحُلُوْلِهَا عُقُوبَاتِكَ
Translation: And by entering them, to Your penalties

Arabic text: وَ وَسِيْلَتِيْ إِلَيْكَ التَّوْحِيدُ
Translation: And my means to You is monotheism

Arabic text: وَ ذَرِيْعَتِيْ أَنِّيْ لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِكَ شَيْئًا
Translation: And my path is that I have not associated anything with You

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ مَعَكَ إِلَهًا
Translation: And I have not taken any god besides You

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ فَرَرْتُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَفْسِي
Translation: And I have fled to You with myself

Arabic text: وَ إِلَيْكَ مَفَرُّ المُسِيءِ
Translation: And to You is the escape of the wrongdoer

Arabic text: وَ مَفْزَعُ الْمُضَيِّعِ لِحَظِّ نَفْسِهِ الْمُلْتَجِي
Translation: And the refuge of one who has squandered his share and seeks protection

Arabic text: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ انْتَضَى عَلَيَّ سَيْفَ عَدَاوَتِهِ
Translation: How many enemies have drawn the sword of enmity against me

Arabic text: وَ شَحَذَ لِيْ ظُبَةَ مُدْيَتِهِ
Translation: And sharpened the edge of their blades for me

Arabic text: وَ أَرْهَفَ لِيْ شَبَا حَدِّهِ
Translation: And honed the sharpness of their edge for me

Arabic text: وَ دَافَ لِيْ قَوَاتِلَ سُمُومِهِ
Translation: And prepared deadly poisons for me

Arabic text: وَ سَدَّدَ نَحْوِيْ صَوَائِبَ سِهَامِهِ
Translation: And aimed their accurate arrows toward me

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ تَنَمْ عَنِّيْ عَيْنُ حِرَاسَتِهِ
Translation: And the eye of their vigilance did not sleep from watching me

Arabic text: وَ أَضْمَرَ أَنْ يَسُومَنِيْ الْمَكْرُوهَ وَ يُجَرِّعَنِيْ زُعَاقَ مَرَارَتِهِ
Translation: And they intended to make me suffer harm and to make me drink the bitterness of their torment

Arabic text: فَنَظَرْتَ يَا إِلَهِيْ إِلَى ضَعْفِيْ عَنِ احْتِمَالِ الْفَوَادِحِ
Translation: Then You looked, my God, at my weakness in bearing calamities

Arabic text: وَ عَجْزِيْ عَنِ الِانْتِصَارِ مِمَّنْ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمُحَارَبَتِهِ
Translation: And my inability to defend myself against those who sought to wage war against me

Arabic text: وَ وَحْدَتِيْ فِيْ كَثِيرِ عَدَدِ مَنْ نَاوَانِي
Translation: And my solitude against the great numbers of those who opposed me

Arabic text: وَ أَرْصَدَ لِيْ بِالْبَلَاءِ فِيمَا لَمْ أُعْمِلْ فِيهِ فِكْرِي
Translation: And prepared affliction for me in matters I had not even considered

Arabic text: فَابْتَدَأْتَنِيْ بِنَصْرِكَ
Translation: So You began by granting me Your support

Arabic text: وَ شَدَدْتَ أَزْرِيْ بِقُوَّتِكَ
Translation: And You strengthened my back with Your power

Arabic text: ثُمَّ فَلَلْتَ لِيْ حَدَّهُ
Translation: Then You blunted their blades for me

Arabic text: وَ صَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ جَمْعٍ عَدِيدٍ وَحْدَهُ
Translation: And after they were many in number, You made them solitary

Arabic text: وَ أَعْلَيْتَ كَعْبِيْ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And You raised my stature above them

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلْتَ مَا سَدَّدَهُ مَرْدُودًا عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And what they aimed, You returned against them

Arabic text: فَرَدَدْتَهُ لَمْ يَشْفِ غَيْظَهُ
Translation: So You repelled them and their rage was not satisfied

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يَسْكُنْ غَلِيلُهُ
Translation: And their burning thirst was not quenched

Arabic text: قَدْ عَضَّ عَلَى شَوَاهُ
Translation: They bit their fingertips in rage

Arabic text: وَ أَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّيًا قَدْ أَخْلَفَتْ سَرَايَاهُ
Translation: And retreated in defeat, their forces having failed

Arabic text: وَ كَمْ مِنْ بَاغٍ بَغَانِيْ بِمَكَايِدِهِ
Translation: How many oppressors sought to oppress me with their plots

Arabic text: وَ نَصَبَ لِيْ شَرَكَ مَصَايِدِهِ
Translation: And set up traps to catch me

Arabic text: وَ وَكَّلَ بِيْ تَفَقُّدَ رِعَايَتِهِ
Translation: And assigned someone to constantly watch me

Arabic text: وَ أَضْبَأَ إِلَيَّ إِضْبَاءَ السَّبُعِ لِطَرِيدَتِهِ
Translation: And lay in wait for me like a predator for its prey

Arabic text: إِنْتِظَارًا لِانْتِهَازِ الْفُرْصَةِ لِفَرِيسَتِهِ
Translation: Waiting to seize the opportunity for its kill

Arabic text: وَ هُوَ يُظْهِرُ لِيْ بَشَاشَةَ الْمَلَقِ
Translation: While showing me a friendly face with flattery

Arabic text: وَ يَنْظُرُنِيْ عَلَى شِدَّةِ الْحَنَقِ
Translation: But looking at me with intense hatred

Arabic text: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ يَا إِلَهِيْ تَبَارَكْتَ وَ تَعَالَيْتَ دَغَلَ سَرِيرَتِهِ
Translation: When You saw, O my God, blessed and exalted are You, the corruption of his inner thoughts

Arabic text: وَ قُبْحَ مَا انْطَوَى عَلَيْهِ، أَرْكَسْتَهُ لِأُمِّ رَأْسِهِ فِيْ زُبْيَتِهِ
Translation: And the ugliness of what he concealed, You threw him headfirst into his own pit

Arabic text: وَ رَدَدْتَهُ فِيْ مَهْوَى حُفْرَتِهِ
Translation: And returned him to the depths of his own hole

Arabic text: فَانْقَمَعَ بَعْدَ اسْتِطَالَتِهِ ذَلِيْلًا فِيْ رِبَقِ حِبَالَتِهِ
Translation: So he was suppressed after his dominance, humiliated in the noose of his own trap

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ كَانَ يُقَدِّرُ أَنْ يَرَانِيْ فِيهَا
Translation: Which he had estimated to see me in

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ كَادَ أَنْ يَحُلَّ بِيْ لَوْلَا رَحْمَتُكَ مَا حَلَّ بِسَاحَتِهِ
Translation: And he would have afflicted me had it not been for Your mercy, with what befell him instead

Arabic text: وَ كَمْ مِنْ حَاسِدٍ قَدْ شَرِقَ بِيْ بِغُصَّتِهِ
Translation: And how many envious ones choked on their distress because of me

Arabic text: وَ شَجِيَ مِنِّيْ بِغَيْظِهِ، وَ سَلَقَنِيْ بِحَدِّ لِسَانِهِ
Translation: And were grieved with rage toward me, and wounded me with the sharpness of their tongue

Arabic text: وَ وَحَرَنِيْ بِقَرْفِ عُيُوبِهِ
Translation: And charged me with their own flaws

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلَ عِرْضِيْ غَرَضًا لِمَرَامِيهِ
Translation: And made my honor a target for their arrows

Arabic text: وَ قَلَّدَنِيْ خِلَالًا لَمْ تَزَلْ فِيهِ
Translation: And attributed to me traits that were actually theirs

Arabic text: وَ وَحَرَنِيْ بِكَيْدِهِ، وَ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمَكِيدَتِهِ
Translation: And wounded me with their deceit, and aimed at me with their plots

Arabic text: فَنَادَيْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِيْ مُسْتَغِيثًا بِكَ
Translation: So I called out to You, my God, seeking Your help

Arabic text: وَاثِقًا بِسُرْعَةِ إِجَابَتِكَ
Translation: Confident in the swiftness of Your response

Arabic text: عَالِمًا أَنَّهُ لَا يُضْطَهَدُ مَنْ أَوَى إِلَى ظِلِّ كَنَفِكَ
Translation: Knowing that whoever seeks refuge in Your protection will not be oppressed

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَفْزَعُ مَنْ لَجَأَ إِلَى مَعْقِلِ انْتِصَارِكَ
Translation: And whoever takes shelter in Your stronghold will not be frightened

Arabic text: فَحَصَّنْتَنِيْ مِنْ بَأْسِهِ بِقُدْرَتِكَ
Translation: So You protected me from their harm by Your power

Arabic text: وَ كَمْ مِنْ سَحَائِبِ مَكْرُوهٍ جَلَّيْتَهَا عَنِّي
Translation: How many clouds of misfortune You cleared away from me

Arabic text: وَ سَحَائِبِ نِعَمٍ أَمْطَرْتَهَا عَلَيَّ
Translation: And clouds of blessings You rained upon me

Arabic text: وَ جَدَاوِلِ رَحْمَةٍ نَشَرْتَهَا
Translation: And streams of mercy You spread

Arabic text: وَ عَافِيَةٍ أَلْبَسْتَهَا، وَ أَعْيُنِ أَحْدَاثٍ طَمَسْتَهَا
Translation: And wellbeing You clothed me with, and evil eyes You blinded

Arabic text: وَ غَوَاشِيَ كُرُبَاتٍ كَشَفْتَهَا
Translation: And coverings of distress You removed

Arabic text: وَ كَمْ مِنْ ظَنٍّ حَسَنٍ حَقَّقْتَ، وَ عَدَمٍ جَبَرْتَ
Translation: How many good expectations You fulfilled, and poverty You remedied

Arabic text: وَ صَرْعَةٍ أَنْعَشْتَ وَ مَسْكَنَةٍ حَوَّلْتَ
Translation: And falls You helped me up from, and hardship You transformed

Arabic text: كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ إِنْعَامًا وَ تَطَوُّلًا مِنْكَ
Translation: All of this as a favor and kindness from You

Arabic text: وَ فِيْ جَمِيْعِهِ انْهِمَاكًا مِنِّيْ عَلَى مَعَاصِيكَ
Translation: And throughout it all, I was immersed in disobeying You

Arabic text: لَمْ تَمْنَعْكَ إِسَاءَتِيْ عَنْ إِتْمَامِ إِحْسَانِكَ
Translation: My wrongdoing did not prevent You from completing Your kindness

Arabic text: وَ لَا حَجَرَنِيْ ذٰلِكَ عَنِ ارْتِكَابِ مَسَاخِطِكَ
Translation: Nor did that stop me from committing what displeases You

Arabic text: لَا تُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَفْعَلُ، وَ لَقَدْ سُئِلْتَ فَأَعْطَيْتَ
Translation: You are not questioned about what You do, and indeed You were asked and You gave

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ تُسْأَلْ فَابْتَدَأْتَ، وَ اسْتُمِيحَ فَضْلُكَ فَمَا أَكْدَيْتَ
Translation: And You were not asked but You initiated, and Your bounty was sought and You did not withhold

Arabic text: أَبَيْتَ يَا مَوْلَايَ إِلَّا إِحْسَانًا
Translation: You refused, O my Master, except to be benevolent

Arabic text: وَ امْتِنَانًا وَ تَطَوُّلًا وَ إِنْعَامًا
Translation: And to bestow favors and to be gracious and to bless

Arabic text: وَ أَبَيْتُ إِلَّا تَقَحُّمًا لِحُرُمَاتِكَ
Translation: And I refused except to violate Your sanctities

Arabic text: وَ تَعَدِّيًا لِحُدُودِكَ، وَ غَفْلَةً عَنْ وَعِيدِكَ
Translation: And to transgress Your limits, and to be heedless of Your warnings

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إِلَهِيْ مِنْ مُقْتَدِرٍ لَا يُغْلَبُ
Translation: So to You belongs all praise, my God, as the All-Powerful who cannot be overcome

Arabic text: وَ ذِيْ أَنَاةٍ لَا يَعْجَلُ
Translation: And the Forbearing who does not act hastily

Arabic text: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسُبُوغِ النِّعَمِ
Translation: This is the position of one who acknowledges the abundance of blessings

Arabic text: وَ قَابَلَهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ، وَ شَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّضْيِيعِ
Translation: Yet met them with shortcomings, and testifies against himself of wasting them

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَإِنِّيْ أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِالْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ
Translation: O Allah, I seek nearness to You through the exalted Muhammadan way

Arabic text: وَ الْعَلَوِيَّةِ الْبَيْضَاءِ، وَ أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِهِمَا
Translation: And the radiant Alawite path, and I turn to You through them

Arabic text: أَنْ تُعِيذَنِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ كَذَا وَ كَذَا، فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ
Translation: That You protect me from the evil of such and such, for indeed that

Arabic text: لَا يَضِيقُ عَلَيْكَ فِيْ وُجْدِكَ
Translation: Is not difficult for You in Your abundance

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ فِيْ قُدْرَتِكَ
Translation: And does not burden You in Your power

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: And You have power over all things

Arabic text: فَهَبْ لِيْ يَا إِلَهِيْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ دَوَامِ تَوْفِيقِكَ
Translation: So grant me, O my God, from Your mercy and continuous success

Arabic text: مَا أَتَّخِذُهُ سُلَّمًا أَعْرُجُ بِهِ إِلَى رِضْوَانِكَ
Translation: What I may take as a ladder to ascend to Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَ آمَنُ بِهِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: And by which I may be safe from Your punishment, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
